notApplicable.reason: Aura Break alters only an Aura-sourced damage bonus; a miss emits no damage operation to invert.
Aura Break does not alter critical-hit selection or ordering; it only negates the selected Aura bonus.
Aura Break does not alter type or move immunity and has no bonus to invert when damage is immune.
Beautiful cures Enraged and has no prevention branch; an absent condition is an intentional no-op.
Blaze changes only a resolved Fire damage roll; a miss has no damage roll to modify.
Blaze does not change critical-hit selection or ordering.
Blaze does not override immunity; its bonus is omitted when no damage resolves.
Confidence requires one authoritative Combat Stat choice once its effect is accepted.
Copy Master requires one authoritative Combat Stat choice once its effect is accepted.
Courage changes only a resolved damage roll; a miss has no damage roll to modify.
Courage does not alter critical-hit selection or ordering.
Courage does not override immunity; its bonus and reduction are omitted when no damage resolves.
Crush Trap explicitly has no Accuracy Roll and therefore its accepted automatic Struggle damage cannot miss.
Damp adds its Water bonus only to a resolved damage roll; a miss has no damage roll to modify.
Damp adds a separate recorded die without changing critical-hit selection or ordering.
Damp does not override immunity; its Water bonus cannot create loss against an immune target.
Dark Art changes only a resolved Dark-type damage roll; a miss has no damage roll to modify.
Dark Art adds a flat roll modifier and does not alter critical-hit selection or ordering.
Dark Art does not override immunity and contributes no loss when the target is immune.
Dark Aura changes only Damage Base for a resolved damage roll; a miss has no damage roll.
Dark Aura changes Damage Base before rolling and does not alter critical-hit selection.
Dark Aura does not override type immunity; an immune recipient still takes no damage.
Dazzling does not open an optional response window; its Interrupt/Priority rule is an automatic restriction once applicable.
Decoy does not open an optional response window; its Interrupt/Priority rule is an automatic restriction once applicable.
Deep Sleep owns no persistent effect to clean up; eligibility is freshly re-evaluated at each authoritative turn end.
Defeatist changes only an existing damage roll; a miss has no damage roll to modify.
Defeatist modifies the damage roll without changing critical-hit selection or ordering.
Defeatist does not override immunity and cannot create damage against an immune target.
Desert Weather owns no persistent lifecycle effect; weather eligibility is freshly projected at each authoritative boundary.
Stealth Rock is a movement-triggered hazard and has no accuracy roll or miss branch.
Stealth Rock hazard HP loss cannot critically hit.
Diamond Defense changes Stealth Rock placement frequency and damage typing but does not change the hazard cleanup policy.
